source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for the division in the Mid-Ulster Mail's nominations list (24 May 1952, p. 5, page image read), which says that only Lissan and Beaghmore are contested

note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Cookstown rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Seventeen candidates were nominated (nine Unionists, six Nationalists, two Independents); Beaghmore and Lissan were contested and the other thirteen nominees were returned unopposed (Mid-Ulster Mail, 24 May 1952, p. 5). No nomination was received for Killycolpy; the paper expected the retiring member, Mr. Patrick J. Duffy, senr., to be re-elected; as the retiring member he was deemed re-elected. Labels are the list's group headings. New member: 'The only newcomer among those returned unopposed is Mr. Charles Richardson, who will represent Oaklands in place of Mr. John Bole'. Returned unopposed.
